title: Runtime internal state attestation (M5 5d)
description: The closed at-least-once delivery body of one Runtime state report: counters and status only. It carries no step names, no checkpoint content, no evidence body and no identity fields.

requestId.description: Idempotency key of this delivery (client-generated UUID). A replay with the same request id answers with the same receipt; the same request id with different content is an explicit conflict.

attempt.description: Dispatch attempts the Runtime itself observed for this run; never the platform's authority.

status.description: The Runtime's internal run status, the same closed state vocabulary as the registry.

checkpointSeq.description: Sequence number of the newest checkpoint the Runtime holds (0 when none).
